coverageCorrection: All seven earlier runtime folders predate repaired R4. Their reported R4 passes checked another owner Convex read isolation and MCP mutation denial; they did not establish second-owner MCP list isolation. Original outcomes and check text are retained, not rewritten. integration-first also does not record R8 or external gaps; these omitted cases cannot be counted as passed. title-edit-missing-feature-control stops at F0; no later title-edit case is established.
